messages:
Ava (Partnerships): Quick sync 1h: EU DST jump coming this weekend. We need a concise playbook that covers ingestion hold, partner comms, and billing fallback for marketplace usage. Can we keep impact to partners minimal?
Sam (Billing): Minimal impact is the goal. From past events, problems come from duplicated events and from partners that emit local timestamps without event ids. I suggest 2-tier approach: (1) hold+replay with extended dedupe; (2) provisional metrics in UI, final bill after reconciliation.
Ravi (Infra): Technical constraints: connectors often send batches with partner_local_ts. If clocks move back an hour we see earlier timestamps and they can be deduped only if event_id present. We should force holding-queue so we can run programmatic filters before commit.
Lin (SI Partner): From the SI side: some of our connectors run on appliances without NTP. We'll push a short checklist to our fleet but expect a few that won't update in time. Could we provide a partner-endpoint to accept "corrected" events after cutover?
Maya (RevOps): We need clear billing rules for partners and for RevOps manual credits. Proposal: provisional invoice generation as normal, but mark affected line-items as "subject to DST adjustment". Any final credit/charge gets included as a single line on the next invoice with explanation. Works for accounting?
Sam (Billing): That works. Concrete rules:
- If we ingest events within T+8h: finalize line-item unchanged.
- If ingested between T+8h and T+24h: mark pending and include provisional; finalize after reconciliation within 24h.
- If >24h: create provisional credit and schedule adjustment next billing cycle.
Maya (RevOps): Need a manual rollback path for invoices if reconciliation finds >1% delta across more than 3 partners. Also need audit log entries for every adjusted line.
Ravi (Infra): Playbook steps (short):
1) T-30m: set collectors to drain mode (stop new polls).
2) T-10m: switch to hold mode: route to dst-hold-1778894444 queue.
3) Cutover happens.
4) T+5m: replay from hold with dedupe based on event_id+partner_id, fallback timestamp-hash with TTL=96h.
5) Run automated reconcile job comparing ingested totals vs partner_report_id.
Commands for ops:
```
# drain
curl -X POST https://internal-api/collectors/flags -d '{"mode":"drain"}'
# hold to named queue
curl -X POST https://internal-api/collectors/flags -d '{"mode":"hold","queue":"dst-hold-1778894444"}'
# replay with extended dedupe
python ops/replay.py --queue dst-hold-1778894444 --dedupe-seconds 14400
```
Lin (SI Partner): Sample partner payload we recommend partners include (we'll ask SIs to send this in smoke tests):
```
{
  "event_id": "uuid-1234",
  "partner_id": "si-omega",
  "sku": "hourly-infer-1",
  "units": 3600,
  "timestamp_utc": "2026-10-31T01:30:00Z"
}
```
Ava (Partnerships): We'll send a partner advisory listing the exact window and the smoke test steps. Proposed timeline: advisory out at T-72h, smoke tests at T-24h, hold at T-10m, replay T+5m, initial reconcile T+6h, final billing adjustments by T+24h.
Sam (Billing): Also: action item for Legal/Finance to approve the "adjustment line" wording and the 24h provisional policy. Maya, can you own?
Maya (RevOps): Yes. I'll draft language and loop in Legal. Also will create a RevOps checklist for manual credits.
Ravi (Infra): Edge cases: connectors that re-replay duplicates after restart. Dedupe strategy: primary key = (event_id, partner_id). If event_id absent, generate deterministic hash over payload fields and apply TTL=96h. We'll log a high-severity alert for partners emitting >1000 non-idempotent events during T-1h..T+6h.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Send DST partner advisory" in 48h.
Lin (SI Partner): We'll run the synthetic smoke test: send 2 events 1 minute apart with explicit event_id and confirm both show in dashboard within 10m. We'll post results in #partner-ops.
Sam (Billing): One more thing: for hourly-prorate products, our prorate job will detect a missing hour chunk and create a provisional credit when partner provides evidence (partner_report_id match + event_id list). Maya please include the acceptance criteria in the RevOps playbook.
Ava (Partnerships): Owners recap: Partnerships (Ava) - partner advisory; Infra (Ravi) - hold/replay infra and runbook; SIs (Lin) - run smoke tests & confirm NTP; Billing (Sam) - finalize billing rules; RevOps (Maya) - credit playbook & Legal sync.
Ravi (Infra): I'll add the runbook to ops-runbooks and link the play commands. Will also add a dashboard widget for "DST ingestion backfill status" showing queued events, replayed events, and reconciliation mismatch rate.
Ava (Partnerships): Great. If nobody objects, I'll send the advisory template after this thread and schedule a short partner call for any SIs with appliances. :thumbsup:
